blocks.p: Angel Cross keeps count. The *Journal* tab of the *Character* window holds a count of the zombies the character has killed, set out by kind, together with the character's own log. Figure 56-1 shows the tab with the *Zombies Killed* section open.

To see the count, open the *Character* window and click the *Journal* tab at its left side. The *Page* pop-up at the top of the tab chooses what the tab shows: the journal, notebooks, papers or recipes. Choose *Journal*. The search box beside the pop-up searches the entries of the log.
The section of counts comes first, under its heading, and the log follows it. Both are described on the facing page, the counts in Table 56-1.

caption: Figure 56-1
The Journal tab, with the Zombies Killed section open.

marks.text: Zombies killed, with the total at the right end of the heading. Click the heading to show or hide the list.
Fire, vehicle and explosion kills have a colored square and count toward the total.
The other rows count kills by weapon type.

sticky.text: The Journal keeps count for you.

blocks.p: The heading of the section gives the total at its right end. Click the heading to show or hide the list. Kills by fire, by a vehicle and by an explosion each have a colored square and count toward the total; the other rows count kills by weapon type. Table 56-1 gives the counts shown in Figure 56-1.

blocks.note: The twelve rows add up to the total in the heading, 212.

blocks.p: Below the counts is the log. Its entries are grouped by month, as the September entry in Figure 56-1 is. To add an entry:

list: Click in the *Write something...* box under the counts.
Click *Save*. The entry is added with the day and time.
